annotation.method: Codex read all 19 physical pages in order, including Sections 1-6, every theorem, corollary, proof and numerical example, and all 38 references; separated Bai's exact results from recalled or cited Lanczos facts and floating-point statements with omitted higher-order terms; audited Mathlib and the exact frozen 44-object NumStability surface; and compiled exact private N/L proofs before retaining P55-T3.
annotation.reason: The project owner assigned the P55 source selection and benchmark annotation to Codex.

corpus_membership: This paper is part of the current corpus listed in metadata/manifest.json.

rejected_candidates.reason: These relations introduce the standard algorithm and recall established Lanczos properties; they are not a new self-contained P55 result with a qualifying tier profile.

Their finite-precision bounds are derived from cited standard saxpy, inner-product, and matrix-vector error models and include unspecified O(epsilon^2) terms. An exact Lean target would require inventing omitted constants or remainder semantics.
The corollary inherits the omitted higher-order terms and norm bounds from Theorem 3.1, so it cannot become an exact source-faithful task without adding data absent from the paper.
The examples and tables are empirical observations rather than universal proof statements.

T1.decision: Skipped. No exact internally proved P55 theorem receives one substantial non-Mathlib shortcut from the frozen NumStability bundle. The apparent floating-point candidates contain unspecified higher-order terms and depend on cited operation-level bounds.

T2.decision: Skipped. No exact source-proved P55 result receives two distinct substantial compiled NumStability shortcuts; making the Section 3 or Corollary 4.1 bounds exact would require invented constants.

T3.decision: Selected Theorem 4.1, equations (4.6)-(4.7), with its exact lower/upper split from equations (4.10)-(4.12). Exact N/L proofs establish substantial matrix-support, decomposition, and eigenvector-cancellation work with no NumStability shortcut.

selection_policy: Use only statements and proof content present in P55.
Do not turn recalled or cited standard Lanczos facts into P55 proof obligations.
Do not manufacture exact constants or remainder semantics for O(epsilon^2) terms.
Express Theorem 4.1 through the exact projected identity and strict-triangular facts used in its proof.
Assign a tier only after exact private N and L proofs compile.
